channel_id.desc: ID of the code channel to remove the view from.

view_id.desc: Encoded channel tab ID of the view to remove. Provide exactly one of view\_key or view\_id. Identify the view by exactly one of `view_key` or `view_id`.

view_key.desc: Agent-assigned key of the view to remove. Provide exactly one of view\_key or view\_id. Identify the view by exactly one of `view_key` or `view_id`.

desc: Remove a view from a code channel.

errors.channel_not_found: The specified channel does not correspond to a valid channel.
errors.not_agent_channel: The specified channel is not a code channel.
errors.not_authorized: The caller is not an authorized agent bot or member for this channel.
errors.not_view_owner: The view was created by a different agent bot; only its owner may remove it.
errors.view_not_found: No agent view matches the supplied view\_key or view\_id in this channel.
errors.view_remove_failed: The view's tab or channel properties could not be updated. Safe to retry.
